note: Literature magnetic Feshbach parameters for 87Rb. |1,+1>+|1,+1> (aa): positions Bexp and theoretical elastic widths Δ from Marte et al., PRL 89, 283202 (2002) [arXiv:cond-mat/0210651] Table I: the four s-wave (l=0) rows and the d-wave (l=2) rows with Δ ≥ 0.2 mG; d-wave rows with Δ < 0.1 mG are omitted. a_bg≈100 a0 from Chin RMP Table IV. Marte Δ is listed in mG and converted to G here. Mixed |1,mF>+|2,mF'> channels near 9 G and 18 G: Kaufman et al., PRA 80, 050701(R) (2009) Table I, with the inelastic decay width γB (a = a_bg[1 − Δ/(B − B0 − iγ/2)]); the 17.821 G a+e line has no fitted width and is omitted. Marte Table II lists further resonances in |1,0>+|1,+1>, |1,0>+|1,0> and |1,-1>+|1,+1> without widths; they are not included. 85Rb has a separate broad resonance near 155 G (Claussen/Chin; not this isotope).
a_bg_ref: Chin et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 82, 1225 (2010) Table IV — 87Rb aa a_bg=100 a0
